{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] sea [[Cookbook:Scallop|scallops]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] bittersweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], melted
* 1 tbsp ground [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] (adjust to your liking)
* [[Cookbook:Parsley|Parsley]], for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

== Procedure ==
#Sprinkle scallops with salt and black pepper.
#Melt butter in a large stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Place scallops in and cook 30 seconds per side. Remove and put on a platter.
#Whisk together chocolate and cayenne pepper. Drizzle on individual plates, place scallops on top, [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] with fresh parsley, and serve.
